checks.expected: 0 new failed requests, or an explained set
checks.actual: run.mjs flagged all 20/20 combinations as 'new-errors-on-b' due to 3-6 newFailedRequestsOnB entries each, all net::ERR_ABORTED on third-party Google Analytics / Google Ads / DoubleClick beacon URLs (analytics.google.com/g/collect, www.google.com/ccm|rmkt/collect, ad.doubleclick.net/ccm/s/collect). Independently reproduced with a standalone Playwright probe against both origins outside the harness: A (www.growmax.io) fires the same domains/endpoints and aborts identically (6 aborted requests on home/desktop in the standalone probe), but run.mjs's newFailedRequests comparison is an exact string match on full request URLs (line ~318 of visual/run.mjs), and every one of these beacon URLs embeds a per-load-unique query string (auid/cid session id, rnd/tft timestamps, rcb cache-buster), so no exact match with A's capture is ever possible even when the identical endpoint fires on both sides. This is a harness classification bug (over-strict exact-URL equality for inherently randomized third-party analytics calls), not a genuine Vercel-only regression -- confirmed by direct reproduction, not merely inferred.

facts.newFailedRequestsRootCause: harness: exact-URL-match comparison against randomized third-party analytics/ad beacon query strings; confirmed symmetric between A and B via independent standalone reproduction (same GA/DoubleClick/Ads endpoints abort with net::ERR_ABORTED on both origins)

classNote: The pixel-diff and console-error signals (the two things VERIFICATION.md's G5.4 text actually gates on) both pass cleanly. The only flagged signal -- SPEC-04 §7's broader 'new failed requests' check, which is a harness implementation detail, not part of the literal gate text -- is a false positive caused by the harness comparing full request URLs by exact string equality; third-party analytics/ad-tracking beacons intentionally randomize their query strings on every page load, so this comparison can never find a match even when the destination host and endpoint are identical on both sides. Independently reproduced outside the harness against both www.growmax.io and growmax-website.vercel.app: both fire the same Google Analytics / Google Ads / DoubleClick collect endpoints and both abort them the same way (net::ERR_ABORTED) in this container's network environment. No evidence of a Vercel-only defect.
recommendation: Non-blocking for G5.4 as the gate is literally written (no new console errors -- satisfied). Owner should still fix scripts/migration/visual/run.mjs's newFailedRequests comparison to match on origin+pathname (or a documented allowlist of third-party analytics domains) instead of the full URL, and add a selftest case, so this signal stops producing 20/20 false positives on every run.
